model_annotations.Bulgarian: This plot illustrates the mean of a hidden state layer across a range of values. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and spans from 0 to 20 with a linear scale and regularly spaced tick labels every 5 units. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean Layer" and spans from 0 to 4 with a linear scale. A blue, dashed line with no markers represents the "hidden state mean before gate," starting at 0.71 and increasing to approximately 2.8 at x = 20. A red, dotted line with no markers represents the "hidden state mean after gate," starting at 0.05 and remaining relatively constant around 0.05 across the x-axis. A green, solid line with no markers represents the "hidden state mean of baseline," starting at 0.04 and remaining relatively constant around 0.04 across the x-axis.
